verdict.rationale: Beglaubigt.de publishes public API docs at docs.beglaubigt.de with concrete REST endpoints under api.beglaubigt.de/v1. These cover notarization, incorporation, translation, tax registration and trade registration, plus status polling, HMAC-signed webhooks and an LLM-oriented llms.txt, which a probe confirmed is live. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (all probed paths returned 404), documented authentication and API-key details, independent or hands-on corroboration, and full API access, since the Compliance API is restricted to Enterprise plans.
